items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Bird and Dizzy and Monk -- all the guys used to go by there.

ctx.x: Do you remember him at Minton's?
Yeah, I used to go up there all the time. That used to be a hangout. Prez used to go up there, and Bird and Dizzy and Monk -- all the guys used to go by there.
Well, the story has been told that they kept an amplifier for him so that he could go and just plug in after he finished with Goodman down at the Paramount...

items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Prez used to go up there, and Bird and Dizzy and Monk -- all the guys used to go by there.

ctx.x: Billy Berg's?" I said, "Not particularly, no. I played there. I just come out of there. I've been there eight weeks. Now I'm going down to San Diego. I'm going to play for..." I can't think of the lady's name; "I'm going to play for her."
So I went down to... I had Red Callender and Teddy Edwards...who else did I have...? A cat named Monk played drums, I think. So anyway, we went down to San Diego...
